info.name: Caris Life Sciences (Public Surface)
info.description: Caris Life Sciences does not publish a public, self-serve developer API. This collection models only the publicly reachable web surfaces (Caris+Portal landing and public informational pages). No third-party developer JSON/REST endpoints are documented by Caris, and none have been invented here.
